decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at E595-06, a 15.4 g/t stope with 260 t. Radio and CMMS agree, and the likely repair is 13:20. Este stockpile has room (170/450) and trucks are not limiting. LH-08 comes from the cheap preparation heading (1.9 oz/h) and takes 0.53 h to get there. It loads about 87 t at 30 t/h before the repair, which is about 44 oz. The heading loses about 7 oz. LH-09 is on the critical-path heading (4 oz/h), so I left it. Taking LH-03 would only move the loss to another producing stope. Net is about +35 oz.
